title: Security & compliance
subtitle: Federated authentication (SSO / Active Directory) and security event export to your SIEM.

sso.intro: Delegate authentication to your identity provider (Azure AD / Entra, ADFS, Okta, Keycloak…). Users whose email belongs to a managed domain are authenticated via SSO.
sso.testFail: Discovery failed: check the Issuer URL.

siem.intro: Forward security events (logins, sensitive data access, configuration changes) to your SIEM sink in real time.
siem.testFail: Failed to send to the SIEM collector.

events.intro: Latest security events logged for this tenant.

trail.intro: The audit trail is chained: every entry carries the digest of the previous one. Altering or removing a row breaks the chain and becomes detectable.
trail.verifyHint: Recomputes the digest chain over the whole log. The check itself is recorded in the trail.
trail.verifyError: The integrity check could not complete.
trail.intact: Trail intact: {{count}} entry/entries checked, no break.
trail.broken: Break detected: the trail has been altered.

reason.hash_mismatch: The entry's content no longer matches its digest: it was rewritten.
reason.broken_link: An entry is missing: the next link points to an absent entry.

trail.purgeMarkers: {{count}} retention purge(s) recorded: erased periods are documented in the trail.
trail.lastHashHint: Keep this digest outside the application (minutes, safe): it will later prove the trail was not rebuilt.
trail.notChained: This tenant was created before chaining: existing entries are not chained, new ones are. No alteration is reported.
trail.exportHint: Produces a CSV file containing the digests, together with its SHA-256 hash and an HMAC seal. A third party can verify it without access to the application. The export is recorded in the trail.
trail.exportedUnsealed: Export downloaded, but NOT SEALED. SHA-256 hash: {{sha}}… — no signing key is configured on the platform: the file is accurate, but a third party cannot prove it came from this application.
trail.exportError: The export could not be produced.
trail.purgeHint: Applies the retention period set by the platform. The purge first writes a marker into the trail — so the erased period stays documented — then deletes older entries.
trail.purged: {{count}} entry/entries deleted (retention: {{days}} days). A marker was recorded in the trail.
trail.purgeUnset: The platform has not set a retention period: the trail is kept indefinitely.
